Formula I = n * sum_ij w_ij c_i c_j / (S0 * sum c_i^2); E[I] = -1/(n-1); z = (I - E[I]) / sqrt(V_rand); p = erfc(|z| / sqrt(2)) for the default two-sided tail. c = x - mean over the n analysis rows; S0 = sum w_ij over included pairs; V_rand is esda VI_rand (sample kurtosis). Geary C and General G use the same z and p with their own moments. For G, E[G] = S0/(n(n-1)); both inference triples report the analytical VG and normal approximation, evaluated in centered form. Binary weights and islands = keep match esda.G; row weights give a weighted generalization. Inference is undefined for n < 4 or S0 = 0. Constant positive data give G variance zero (z and p undefined); G also requires non-negative values and a positive pair-product denominator.
